description:
The final level theme of ~omh~, actually being a remix of various Mario victory themes, with a nod to real final because R-ACK. Won 1st place during Winter C3 2024 alongside a bunch of other ~omh~ related songs.

Give credit if you use this, please.

Not compatible with thunder, p-switch, blarggs, etc.
